questions.content: Consider two straight lines, each of which is tangent to both the circle x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> = (1/2) and the parabola y<sup>2</sup> = 4x. Let these lines intersect at the point Q. Consider the ellipse whose centre is at the origin O(0, 0) and whose semi-major axis is OQ.
